# PrescriptionMaker

> PrescriptionMaker is a digital prescription documentation tool for doctors and clinics in India.

PrescriptionMaker allows healthcare professionals to create, format, and export professional prescription documents as PDFs. It is a documentation tool — not a medical advice or AI diagnostics system.

## Product

- Homepage: https://prescriptionmaker.in

## Core Features

- 15+ professional prescription templates (Classic Medical, Minimal Clinical, Modern Clinic, Pediatric, Hospital, Specialist, Premium White, and more)
- Form-filling editor with structured fields: doctor info, patient info, diagnosis, vitals, medicines (dose/frequency/duration/route), lab tests, advice, follow-up
- Hand-mode canvas editor: write or draw prescriptions using mouse, touch, or stylus
- A4 PDF export with selectable text
- Autosave and draft management
- Secure authentication with JWT + HTTP-only cookies
- Built for Indian doctors and clinics

## Pricing Plans

- Free: Up to 10 prescriptions/month, 3 templates, PDF export
- Pro: ₹299/month — Unlimited prescriptions, all templates, Hand Mode editor, custom branding
- Enterprise: ₹999/month — All Pro features + priority support + 10 team members

## Disclaimer

PrescriptionMaker is a documentation tool. It does not provide medical advice, diagnoses, or treatment recommendations. All clinical decisions are made by licensed healthcare professionals.
